doc.brief: An opaque structure representing a watched `GtkExpression`.
doc.md:
An opaque structure representing a watched `GtkExpression`.

The contents of `GtkExpressionWatch` should only be accessed through the
provided API.

evaluate.brief: Evaluates the watched expression and on success stores the result in `value`.
evaluate.md:
Evaluates the watched expression and on success stores the result
in `value`.

This is equivalent to calling [`Expression.evaluate()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Expression#method:evaluate) with the
expression and this pointer originally used to create `watch`.

ref.brief: Acquires a reference on the given `GtkExpressionWatch`.
ref.md: Acquires a reference on the given `GtkExpressionWatch`.

unref.brief: Releases a reference on the given `GtkExpressionWatch`.
unref.md:
Releases a reference on the given `GtkExpressionWatch`.

If the reference was the last, the resources associated to `self` are
freed.

unwatch.md:
Stops watching an expression.

See [`Expression.watch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Expression#method:watch) for how the watch
was established.
